scientific_scope_status: Actual completed reviews accept two useful harmonic alternatives and their resource boundaries. Full-range opposite paired currents can remove total circulation while preserving the COMPLETEfinite-Ndensity path law. A different local elastic-memory construction preserves stationary ordinary density-fluctuation whole paths and caps macroscopic circulation by paying growing prepared memory covariance. It freezes order-one density modes and retains ordinary CLTcurrent noise, so it does not replace the full nonlocal rare-history action.
